tabs.name: MiniMax M2
tabs.note: The chat template opens the `think` tag for the model, so the output starts mid-thought and only the closing tag appears. Everything before the closing tag is reasoning. vLLM's `minimax_m2_append_think` parser keeps it in content and adds the opening tag back, so you send the whole block back.

panes.label: Turn it on
panes.src:
--reasoning-parser minimax_m2
# or minimax_m2_append_think to keep it in content

panes.label: Where it shows up
panes.src:
Need the weather for Tokyo.</think>

<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="get_weather">
<parameter name="city">Tokyo</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
